notes.title: Bug Fixes and New Mode: Save Game Issue Resolved and Hunter Defense Mode Added!
notes.content:
Patch Update [Version 1,1]
Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where game progress would be lost when returning to the main menu. Your game should now save properly when exiting via the main menu.
New Features:

New Mode Added: A brand new mode has been introduced! Test your skills in the new Hunter Defense mode, where waves of hunters will try to invade.
Customize your own dungeon and choose the level of challenge that suits you.
Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We hope you enjoy these new features and improvements!

notes.title: Zoul Dungeon is now available!
notes.content:
Zoul Dungeon is now available! Take control as the dungeon master and defend your treasures from invading adventurers. Summon powerful monsters, upgrade your dungeon, and unlock deadly traps to stop anyone who dares enter. Start your journey as the ultimate dungeon overlord today!
